Quoted Pipeline — Live from AgencyZoom
#CustomerSourcePipelineQuoted PremiumCreatedLast Activityx-Date

Computed per the Ironwood Insurance 2026 California Producer Compensation Plan (effective Jan 1, 2026), applied to real confirmed sales for the selected folio. Qualify with $20,000+ premium AND 2+ Life term policies (or 1 IUL policy), OR $50,000+ total premium (any mix). Tier is set by total premium per the plan's table: 6% at $20K, 7% at $40K, 8% at $60K, 9% at $80K, 10% at $100K+. Full tier rate applies to Farmers/Foremost premium, half tier rate to Brokered premium, flat 50% to Broker Fee premium (all gated on qualifying), plus a +2% accelerator once total premium exceeds $120K. Only carrier-confirmed premium counts toward qualification — unconfirmed premium is excluded until confirmed. No IUL sales are on record, so that qualification path isn't currently in play.
